Mariam Okoye: Quick announce: Observability team is splitting into Observability and CostOps next week. Goal: clearer ownership for metrics vs. unit-economics work.
Diego Morales: Congrats folks. How will the leads be assigned?
Mariam Okoye: Nora will lead Observability (dashboards, alerts). Priya will lead CostOps (billing, cost tooling). Both start Monday.
Nora Elbaz: Excited! Immediate ask: folks in obs sprint, please flag any work that should transfer.
Priya Natarajan: For hiring, we have 4 approved headcount slots: 2 SREs (obs), 1 cost analyst, 1 infra-eng (quota/ingestion). People Ops: please confirm HC flow.
Headcount Bot: Note: new slots require HC request form v2 with business owner + ROI field. Template: /tools/hc-request.
Lizzy Mendoza: Confirmed 1: People Ops will triage priority hires this week. Hiring pause exceptions apply (revenue/SLA/security). Managers: submit v2 forms by EOD Wed.
Diego Morales: Any changes to oncall rotations during transition?
Nora Elbaz: Short term we'll keep current rota; Priya and I will coordinate shadow swaps.
Mariam Okoye: Action items: 1) Managers submit HC v2 forms 2) Teams tag transfer tickets with #obs-split 3) People Ops publish updated org chart.
Diego Morales: Thanks, will share transfer list by tomorrow.
Lizzy Mendoza: Welcome Nora and Priya :tada: — we'll run a town hall Fri 11am PT to walk through org changes. RSVP on calendar.
